events.text: The Beggars' Sect holds its great court. Anyone may bring a grievance before the Beggar King.

choices.text: Bring a grievance for the poor

effects.log: The King hears it and sends his people. Justice, beggar style.
A court of rags with more honour than any palace.

events.text: A beggar asks you for a coin. It is a test the Beggars' Sect uses on strangers.

effects.log: Word spreads among the beggars: you are a friend.
The beggar smiles: the right answer.

events.text: A Beggar elder demonstrates the Green Bamboo Staff in the square.

effects.log: Dozens of moves, and one idea: never where they expect.
'Beg for a year first,' he laughs.

events.text: A beggar has been selling the sect's secrets to a rich merchant.

ok.log: You bring proof to the King. The sect owes you.

fail.log: He sees you coming and runs.

effects.log: They set their own trap.

events.text: The beggars hold a feast with food gathered from a hundred kitchens.

effects.log: Strange food, true friends.
Your roast duck is the hit of the night.

events.text: A rich man insults the beggars at his gate and sets his dogs on them.

choices.text: Stand between the dogs and the beggars

ok.log: The dogs back down. So does the man.

fail.log: Bitten, but the beggars are safe.

choices.text: Report him to the Beggar King

effects.log: The next morning, beggars sit at his gate. All of them. For a month.

events.text: The Beggar King poses a riddle to the crowd: 'What does a beggar own that a king cannot buy?'

ok.log: 'Freedom.' The King laughs and gives you his bowl.

fail.log: 'Fleas.' The crowd roars. Not the answer, but beloved.

effects.log: Every answer says something true.

events.text: Children beg in the court, orphans of the winter.

choices.text: Find them places in the sect

effects.log: The Beggars take them in. They will eat.
Twenty buns, twenty smiles. (−2 taels)

events.text: A beggar child your age shows you how to whistle with a grass blade.

effects.log: Your whistle is terrible and joyful.
A friend for the whole winter.

events.text: An abandoned temple where the beggars keep their records under the altar.

effects.log: Some secrets are not yours.
The next day, a chalk mark on your door: friend.

events.text: A famous master attends the court disguised as a beggar. You notice their hands.

effects.log: Later, they nod to you: you have good eyes.
They smile under the dirt.

events.text: The court ends with every beggar banging their bowls together, a sound like rain.

effects.log: You are an honorary beggar for a night.
The sect will feed many. (−5 taels)
